entries.title: For this belly
entries.literal_meaning: This belly! For this belly, the road to Bengal.
entries.explanation: The repeated belly gives a bodily reason for the journey. The dictionary explains the phrase through Puri panda agents travelling to Bengal to gather pilgrims. Our reading hears livelihood behind the repeated exclamation: a route is taken because someone must eat. The source supplies no named traveller, dated journey or testimony.
entries.meaning_odia: ପେଟର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ଯାତ୍ରାର ଏକ ଦେହସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ କାରଣ ଦିଏ। ଅଭିଧାନ ଏହି ପଦକୁ ପୁରୀର ପଣ୍ଡା ଗୁମାସ୍ତାମାନେ ଯାତ୍ରୀ ସଂଗ୍ରହ ପାଇଁ ବଙ୍ଗଦେଶକୁ ଯିବା ସହ ବୁଝାଏ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ପୁନରୁକ୍ତ ଡାକ ପଛରେ ଜୀବିକା ଶୁଣାଯାଏ—ଖାଇବାର ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ପାଇଁ ବାଟ ଧରାଯାଏ। କୌଣସି ନାମିତ ଯାତ୍ରୀ, ତାରିଖ ଥିବା ଯାତ୍ରା ବା ସାକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଉତ୍ସ ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading hears the need for livelihood behind a named route.
entries.odia_summary: ନାମିତ ବାଟ ପଛରେ ଜୀବିକାର ଆବଶ୍ୟକତାକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ଶୁଣେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଦୂରକୁ କାମ ପାଇଁ ଯାଉଥିବା ଜଣେ ସାଙ୍ଗ ଢଗଟି ମନେ ପକାଇ କହିଲେ, “ମୋ ବାଟ ବଙ୍ଗଳାକୁ ନୁହେଁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ପେଟର କଥାଟି ବୁଝୁଛି।” / A friend leaving for work far away recalls the saying: “My route is not to Bengal, but I understand the part about earning a meal.” This modern use is invented, not a documented pilgrimage account.
entries.cultural_context: The Puri label and agent explanation belong to this dictionary witness. They do not establish the saying’s origin, current recruitment practice or a motive shared by every practitioner.

entries.title: Onion and interest
entries.literal_meaning: Hindus do not eat onions; Pathans do not eat interest.
entries.explanation: The rhyme pairs eating onions with “eating” interest, giving two prohibitions the same verbal shape. The dictionary glosses biaja as loan interest and adds a religious explanation. Our critical reading notices how the line turns named communities into categorical statements. We retain those words as historical rhetoric, not as evidence of everyone’s diet, conduct or beliefs.
entries.meaning_odia: ପିଆଜ ଖାଇବା ସହ ସୁଧ “ଖାଇବା”କୁ ମେଳ ଦେଇ ଦୁଇ ନିଷେଧକୁ ଏକା ବାକ୍ୟଛାଞ୍ଚରେ ରଖାଯାଇଛି। ଅଭିଧାନ ବିଆଜର ଅର୍ଥ ଋଣର ସୁଧ ଦିଏ ଓ ଧାର୍ମିକ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପଢ଼ା ଦେଖେ କିପରି ନାମିତ ସମୁଦାୟକୁ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏକାଭଳି ଦାବିରେ ବଦଳାଯାଏ। ଏହି ଶବ୍ଦକୁ ଐତିହାସିକ କଥନ ଭାବେ ରଖୁଛୁ, ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ଖାଦ୍ୟ, ଆଚରଣ ବା ବିଶ୍ୱାସର ପ୍ରମାଣ ଭାବେ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: A rhyme makes categorical community claims that our reading questions.
entries.odia_summary: ଛନ୍ଦରେ ଗଢ଼ା ସମୁଦାୟର ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ବିଷୟରେ ଦାବିକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, “ପିଆଜ ଓ ବିଆଜର ମେଳ ମନେ ରହେ; ତେଣୁ କଥାଟି ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ସତ ହୋଇଯାଏ କି?” ଆଲୋଚନାଟି ଶବ୍ଦର ମେଳ ଓ ଦାବିର ପ୍ରମାଣ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ତଫାତ ନେଇ ଚାଲିଲା। / A reading-group member asks, “The rhyme is memorable; does that make its claim true for everyone?” The group discusses the difference between verbal neatness and evidence. This exchange is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Pathan is the quotation’s term; the following note speaks more broadly of Muslims. That shift is not silently treated as identity equivalence. No present religious ruling or financial guidance is offered.
